briefing.headline: Soft landing holds as inflation edges higher while growth slows but jobs remain firm.

quotable_numbers.sentence: Core CPI at 2.6 percent for Sep 2026 is settling near the Fed's target, keeping rate cuts measured.
Unemployment at 4.2 percent for Sep 2026 holds steady, anchoring household spending power.

briefing.whats_new: Today: 10-Year Treasury cooler, from 4.90 percent to 4.84 percent.
